owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

registerSeries(address,bytes32,bytes32,b.notice: One series = one Noto token. `token` is never re-registrable once set, matching "1 series = 1 ISIN = 1 Noto token" from the doc's Hierarchy section -- a reopening (tap) mints more supply on the SAME already-registered token, it never calls this again.

updateTerms(address,bytes32).notice: `newTermsHash` = sha256(JCS(terms)) of the full ICMA terms JSON held in BI's own DB (bond_series.terms, per the doc's Off-chain section) -- this contract never sees the terms themselves, only the anchor hash. History of prior hashes/versions is kept off-chain; this only needs to prove, on request, that whatever BI currently claims matches what was anchored on-chain at that version.
